name: rung
description: Rung: numbers organic search results and pins notes to any page or site
author: Alexey Bogomolov

scripts.dev: npm run clean && (vite build --watch --mode development & vite build --config vite.popup.config.ts --watch --mode development)
scripts.build: npm run clean && vite build && vite build --config vite.popup.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.package: npm run build && cd dist && zip -qr ../serp-counter-tool.zip .
scripts.store-assets: npm run build && STORE_ASSETS=1 playwright test e2e/store-assets.spec.ts
